blocks.text: Gharon aur shehron ka waste pani ki pollution ke bare sources mein se ek hai. Bohat se ilaqon mein shehron ka bina saaf kiya ya kam saaf kiya gaya sewage aur thos kachra seedha daryaon, jheelon ya samandaron mein daal diya jata hai, jis se nuqsan-deh bacteria aur viruses pani mein aa jate hain. Gharon ka waste, jaise detergents, tel aur chemicals, naaliyon mein ja kar aakhir pani tak pohanchta hai. Khaas taur par plastic aksar naaliyon aur nehron mein ya un ke qareeb phenka jata hai, jis se raaste band (blockage) hote hain aur lambe arse ki pollution hoti hai.
